description: Source code implementing a Direct3D 9 swap chain class for the ANGLE graphics library, including resource management, resizing, and presentation logic.

classes.name: SwapChain9
classes.description: A class managing a Direct3D 9 swap chain, handling resource creation, resizing, presentation, and resource access.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases all Direct3D resources associated with the swap chain.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the swap chain buffers by recreating the swap chain with new dimensions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reinitializes the swap chain and associated resources with specified dimensions and swap interval.

methods.name: swapRect
methods.description: Performs a partial presentation of the swap chain, rendering a specified rectangle.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the current render target surface, incrementing its reference count.

methods.name: getDepthStencil
methods.description: Returns the current depth stencil surface, incrementing its reference count.

methods.name: getOffscreenTexture
methods.description: Returns the offscreen texture, incrementing its reference count.

methods.name: recreate
methods.description: Recreates the swap chain, typically after device loss.
